title: About our online store
heroImageAlt: Freshly baked Pideh pide on a cream table
paragraphs: The fast-food chain was founded in 2020 by restaurateur Areg Gevorgyan — also known as Restormania. The project is built on a simple idea of quick food: tasty, high-quality, and filling meals at an accessible price.

Pideh is a convenient choice for anyone who wants a quick meal during the day without giving up taste or quality. The concept combines fast service, affordable prices, and satisfying food — a good fit for dining in or ordering ahead.

Over the years, Pideh has built a recognizable style and a loyal circle of guests. Today the chain has two addresses in Yerevan: Yeznik Koghbatsi St. 83 and Zoravar Andranik St. 151/2. Pideh’s goal is to keep developing fast-food culture while balancing quality, accessibility, and convenience.
